text:
maria: CI microbench flagged a ~12% tail-latency regression on PR 21500 after the recent scheduler change. temp queue oscillation + kernel affinity path looks suspicious. https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/21500/queue_latency.png

ci-bot: microbench/queue_latency exceeded threshold (baseline 18ms -> 20.2ms, +12%). Full log: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/21500/queue_latency.log :warning:

dmitri: looking now. Can someone paste the microbench command used?

sara: command in CI: `pytest -k micro_queue --bench=queue_latency --batch_size=16 --seed=42`

jordan: fwiw I repro locally with --batch_size=16 w/ a cold KV cache. tail gets worse over time (not a single spike).

maria: repo link: https://git.redwood/inference/runtime. Suspect merge: scheduler-autotune (#21288) landed in the same window.

sara: quick local gist of output:
```
queue_latency: p95=18.1ms p99=29.4ms
after merge: p95=20.3ms p99=34.8ms
profile: kernel_selector chose kernel_v2 for seq_len=64 more often
kv_hit_rate: 0.78 -> 0.74
```

dmitri: kernel_v2 has different batching behavior and slightly higher per-token overhead for small batches. If scheduler_autotune nudged affinity toward kernel_v2 for many short lived queues that could explain oscillation.

jordan: running a bisect range now: starting at commit before #21288 to HEAD. will report ASAP.

ci-bot: Note: the CI run that failed used shadow routing to kernel_v2 for 30% of requests (traffic-split config).

maria: good call. If shadowing amplified cold-path batch churn, that could lower KV hit rate and increase tail.

sara: quick experiment: forced kernel_v1 locally -> p95/p99 back to baseline. So kernel selection is correlated.

dmitri: can we try a config revert: disable the autotune affinity rule in the runtime config and rerun CI? If that fixes, we either revert the change or throttle shadowing.

maria: I'll push a revert candidate to the PR branch and trigger CI. `git revert --no-commit 3f9a2bc` (the autotune commit)

jordan: bisect result: culprit narrowed to commit 3f9a2bc (scheduler-autotune). Confirmed on two machines.

maria: thanks. I'll open a rollback PR and mark this a rollout blocker. tagging @oncall for visibility :rotating_light:

ci-bot: New PR created: #21510 rollback scheduler-autotune. CI job queued.

sara: note for postmortem: add a microbench variant that forces KV coldstarts + shadowed kernel_v2 to catch this pattern earlier. Also add a threshold alert on kv_hit_rate drop correlated with tail.

dmitri: agreed. I'll draft the microbench and add a small flamegraph check to CI.

maria: plan: merge rollback on green, then followup smaller change to autotune to respect kv_hit_rate heuristics. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
